about_the_game:
Evil Empire Rises Again

The ultimate greed simulator returns with custom recipes!

The lemonade kid is once again ready to destroy the world in the name of profit.

Start by selling lemonade in the neighbourhood and grow into a global empire! Manage factories and control the political winds of the world.

Make sure global temperatures rise, so people buy more beverages! Use that money for a Presidential campaign, and use that power to also sway the international country's politics to your favor.

A Grand Strategy Cooking game inside a Clicker, you ask? Yup!

70+ unique ingredients

Unlock and gather ingredients with unique properties that affect the final lemonade mix. Increase demand, utilize different conditional effects, and boost sales by minmaxing ingredients!

Dynamic sales

Weather, and other conditions affect your sales. Switch between recipes to make the most out of conditions.

AFFECT POLITICS

Ingredients sourced from certain areas affect politics, and could help you gain power!

SUPPLY & DEMAND SIM

At its core is the supply and demand mechanic. Use dubious means to manipulate demand.

EVOLVING GAMEPLAY OVER 3 CHAPTERS

Gradually unlock new properties for ingredients, as well as new mini games!

EXPLORE CUSTOM RECIPES

With over 70 different ingredients, your minmaxing needs will be quenched!

  • Cups

  • Fruits

  • Sweeteners

  • Ice

  • Special

Ingredients consume volume, and cups have different volume capacities!

MANAGE A FACTORY

Manage the lemonade production with employees - and look out for unions! In the first chapter you make one lemonade at a time but this scene features:

  • Multiple production lines

  • Bulk sales

  • World wide sales

  • Union squashing (if you want)

WORLD DOMINATION

Get involved in politics once you reach enough influence:

  • Control the training of AI.

  • Tear down rainforests

  • Make sure no pro-climate laws are passed.

Because people drink more when it's hot outside!

NUMBERS GO UP

It's an incremental game. Expect to become filthy rich, and the worlds first trillionaire... and beyond.

HANDDRAWN ART

All art is drawn by hand with a unique style.

FEATURES

  • Story driven incremental clicker with deckbuilding-like gameplay.

  • Custom recipes

  • Over 50 ingredients with unique properties

  • Prestige when you finish the story

  • Supply & demand sim

  • Gameplay that evolves with your choices

  • 27 different story endings

  • Multiple mini-games
